GraceDeployment.Target: Package distribution, not a deployed service: the @osovv/grace-cli npm package (Bun-powered grace binary) and the Claude Code marketplace plugin packaged under plugins/grace with an OpenPackage manifest.
GraceDeployment.Notes: Release gates run through bun run validate:release (typecheck, full bun test, CLI validation, release:check, validate-marketplace, packed-CLI smoke) before publish; see RELEASING.md. There are no running environments or rollback surface beyond npm/marketplace versioning.
